examples.arabic: هن أكلوا خبز تازه وحمص طيب.
examples.english: They ate fresh bread and delicious hummus.
examples.transliteration: Hinne akalu khubz taza wa hummus tayyeb.

examples.english: But the food is burnt and not tasty.
examples.transliteration: bas el akel mahrouq w mu tayyeb

examples.arabic: اكيد بدنا نحضر اكل طيب ومي باردة كثير عشان نستمتع هناك
examples.english: Of course, we need to prepare tasty food and a lot of cold water so we can enjoy ourselves there.
examples.transliteration: Akid bedna nhaddir akel tayyeb w mayy barde ktir 'ashan nestamte' hnak.

examples.arabic: امي قالت اي عندي كعك طيب
examples.english: Mom said, 'Yes, I have delicious cookies.'
examples.transliteration: Emmi alet ee endi ka'ek tayyeb

examples.english: We ate delicious food and drank tea.
examples.transliteration: Akalna akel ṭayyib w sheribna shay.

examples.english: We all ate a delicious dinner together.
